VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Ladies and Gentlemen,
IndiGo is negotiating one of the boldest bets in its 20-year history to place an order for 150 new aircrafts !!!
And if this deal goes through, It could change the fortunes of tier-2 cities like Patna, Indore, Varanasi and Bhubaneswar because all of them will have a direct flight between each other!!!
And a direct flight does something crazy to a city's economy!!
Think about what new airports have already done!!
Around the new Navi Mumbai airport, property prices in Dronagiri jumped 41.9%. Panvel, 26%. Kharghar, 20%.
Near the new Noida airport, Greater Noida prices are up 79% in just two years. And in North Goa, because of the new Mopa airport, prices are up 77%!!
And now the same thing could happen in Coimbatore, Lucknow, Nagpur and dozens of other cities!!!
But the problem is
Almost every airline that tried to make money flying between India's smaller cities has failed.
The government tried with the UDAN scheme with 774 subsidised routes and 720 of them were gone once the subsidy ended !!
Then an airline called Air Costa tried in 2013,
But it lost ₹130 crore in a single year and shut down in 2017!!
TruJet tried in 2015, but it lost ₹143 crore in a single year and shut down in 2022, and so did at least 8 other airlines!!!
The question is,
When so many airlines failed, Why is IndiGo taking the risk of launching these routes?
What business strategy are they deploying to place orders for 150 jets?
Why did so many airlines fail in these routes?
And if Indigo succeeds how could this change the fortune of these cities?
